mods.title: Autosave
mods.author: chrispanella
mods.summary: Autosaves your game on events (catch, level up, evolve, trainer battle) or a timer - your choice in OPTIONS.

mods.title: Battle Challenges
mods.author: chrispanella
mods.summary: Every optional battle challenge in one mod (formerly rocket_recruits, roaming_boss, legendary_shrine, fun_trainer_ace, veteran): eight wandering trainers who ask before a fight, a re-battleable veteran in Viridian, a daily roaming Team Rocket gang that moves as a formation, a roaming Champion that changes cities every few days, and a daily rotating legendary on Route 10. All read the tweaks BATTLE DIFF setting to scale their teams.

mods.title: Crafting & Alchemy
mods.author: chrispanella
mods.summary: A crafting hub you open at a bench (Cerulean or Celadon). The main menu branches into ALCHEMY (potions and status heals), COOKING (badge-gated buff food that raises a Pokemon's stats when eaten in battle - each region unlocks a better dish), ENGINEERING (Poke/Great/Ultra Balls, fishing rods, a bicycle), a TM LAB (craft TMs and a few HMs from Tech Shards), and GATHERING (a view of your materials). Each discipline has its own level that rises as you craft and unlocks better recipes. Materials come from foraging spots on routes (refill weekly, placed off the main path) and a chance drop after winning wild battles; both also raise your Gathering level.

mods.title: Friendships
mods.author: chrispanella
mods.summary: Build relationships with six townsfolk over real-world days; warmer greetings and gifts as bonds grow.

mods.title: Town Lottery
mods.author: chrispanella
mods.summary: A lottery vendor stands outside the mart in every town. Buy a cheap ticket (100) and lock in a number from 1 to 100. Draws happen every Wednesday and Saturday; match the drawn number to win a 50000 jackpot, collectable from any vendor after the draw. The winning number is fixed by the draw's date, so it is the same at every vendor. Spawned at runtime, no map edits.

mods.title: New Area: Clubhouse
mods.author: chrispanella
mods.summary: A worked example of adding a brand-new map: a Clubhouse room off Pallet Town with its own NPC.

mods.title: Quest Pack
mods.author: chrispanella
mods.summary: Every quest in one pack, plus a QUESTS entry in the START menu that tracks them. Includes the Glow Shard fetch quest, four Town Quests, five Branching Quests with multiple endings, and three Move Tutors: masters who spawn on quiet routes and teach your trainer a signature move (a TM you cannot craft) once you beat their team. Tracked in the QUESTS menu.

mods.title: Town Gifts
mods.author: chrispanella
mods.summary: Friendly townsfolk who hand out gifts, all in one mod (formerly daily_gift, wonder_trader, berry_grove, daily_coins, type_sage, and starter_pack): a free item, a rare Pokemon, a healing item, and Game Corner coins each once per real week, a rotating weekly type tip, and a one-time welcome kit from a spawned NPC in Pewter that leaves for good once claimed.

mods.title: Traveling Merchants
mods.author: chrispanella
mods.summary: Five distinct merchant NPCs out on the routes; their locations and stock rotate on real-world days.

mods.title: Tweaks & Settings
mods.author: chrispanella
mods.summary: A shared settings hub. Adds one OPTIONS panel that controls the on-screen popups every mod uses (off / text-only / full bar, plus color, size, bold, duration, and a sound toggle) and a BATTLE DIFF setting (Normal/Hard/Brutal) that the challenge mods read to make their teams tougher. Other mods use it when present and fall back to their own defaults when it is not.

mods.title: Visual Pack
mods.author: chrispanella
mods.summary: Every visual enhancement in one pack. Each effect is its own render pipeline with its own OPTIONS row and on/off ladder, and they stack: DAY/NIGHT lighting (time-aware), CRT lines, vignette, letterbox, weather (rain/snow/fog), ambient motes, RGB split, film grain, night stars, color grade, and duotone (GB green / sepia / noir). Safe overlay/color techniques with shader fallbacks; no engine files edited.

mods.title: World Clock
mods.author: chrispanella
mods.summary: An in-game playtime clock that persists with the save and publishes time + day/hour events for other mods.
